CustomField.description: How the advisor expressed this sleeve's allocation. Dollar sleeves are fixed carve-outs that should not float with account value. Percent sleeves describe the actively traded remainder after all Dollar sleeves on the same Order Ticket and must total 100% across the ticket. Blank on rows created before this field existed (treat as Percent of total, the legacy convention).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Dollar = fixed amount that does not float with account value. Percent = share of the remainder after fixed-dollar sleeves.
CustomField.label: Funding Basis
